design.primal_orbit: each field-cell centroid enclosed by its four native-node gradient samples
design.dual_orbit: each interior native node enclosed by four surrounding field-centroid samples, evaluated by gradient_cell_degree on the centroid lattice
design.duplicate_rule: same signed index, opposite orbit family, and position-only quadratic refinements separated by no more than half the minimum cell pitch
design.shape_contract: candidates remain masked in fixed slots; no data-dependent compaction is used

capacity_per_signed_index.work_above_64: 2 * k_slots, bounded by the native cell count

grid.coordinates: integer nodes from -4 through 4; unit pitch

generic_interior_saddle.verdict: the staggered family contributes corroborating evidence and does not invent a second reported root

iter_acceptance.verdict: NOT RECOVERED: the dual sweep still finds no saddle before containment; the ITER absence is outside this partition-boundary guard and remains a broader detector limitation or field-data fault

cpu_cost_per_slice_compilation_excluded.method: 30 alternating warmed calls per route on the same analytic saddle; median and interquartile range
cpu_cost_per_slice_compilation_excluded.qualification: The 129x129 distributions are bimodal under concurrent CPU load; retain the measured intervals and do not interpret the 4.02x median as an isolated throughput constant.
